strengths.text: You checked the live roster before answering, so the parent saw you solving her real problem instead of reciting a pitch.
You framed the course around focus and resilience through stories, which is exactly the framing the policy requires.

fixes.text: A one-line wrap-up locks in the next step and protects you from a stale CRM.
fixes.better_line: I've sent the link and noted the Sat-Sun 9:30 AM batch. I'll check in at 12 noon in case anything needs fixing.

fixes.text: State the refund with its condition.
fixes.better_line: Full refund within 14 days if no more than 4 classes have been attended.

coaching.next_call_drill: After every call, update the CRM stage before opening the next lead. (Her payment arrived 2 hours later and the stage never changed.)
